content.title: Jesus, Criteria, and the Demise of Authenticity
content.author: Chris Keith and Anthony Le Donne, editors (London: T&T Clark, 2012)
content.note: Essays arguing that the 'criteria of authenticity' (dissimilarity, multiple attestation, embarrassment) cannot sort sayings into authentic and inauthentic, and proposing memory approaches instead. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
